tool.name: nf-core haplocheck
tool.description: Haplocheck detects contamination patterns in mtDNA AND WGS sequencing studies by analyzing the mitochondrial DNA. Haplocheck also works as a proxy tool for nDNA studies and provides users a graphical report to investigate the contamination further. Internally, it uses the Haplogrep tool, that supports rCRS and RSRS mitochondrial versions.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ haplocheck --raw --out $prefix $vcf
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": haplocheck: \$(echo \$(haplocheck --version 2>&1) | sed 's/.*\\([0-9].[0-9].[0-9]\\).*/\\1/' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Haplocheck detects contamination patterns in mtDNA AND WGS sequencing studies by analyzing the mitochondrial DNA. Haplocheck also works as a proxy tool for nDNA studies and provides users a graphical report to investigate the contamination further. Internally, it uses the Haplogrep tool, that supports rCRS and RSRS mitochondrial versions.
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: haplocheck Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/haplocheck ]]>
